verdict.rationale: Bugbot leaves inline comments with suggested fixes, and each finding offers 'Fix in Cursor' (IDE) and 'Fix in Web' (cursor.com/agents) links that hand it to an agent to generate a fix. However, both paths take the developer out of the PR into Cursor's IDE or web agent UI. Nothing shows a one-click committed patch or an agent follow-up triggered from inside the PR itself. Missing for 10: in-PR apply/commit of suggested fixes, evidence that the agent fix is pushed back to the same PR branch, and independent hands-on corroboration of the fix workflow.
